lead_fa: Enhancement یک اسپک میله‌ای تند و battlemage است: با ضربه‌های افسون‌شده مثل [[Stormstrike]]]] و [[Lava Lash]]]] و [[Crash Lightning]] استک‌های [[Maelstrom Weapon]] را می‌سازی و در 9 استک یا بیشتر با اسپل‌های آنی مثل [[Lightning Bolt]] یا [[Chain Lightning]] خرج می‌کنی. دو مسیر Hero Tree داری: [[Stormbringer]] که با تنظیم Season 2 اسپک غالب است و برچسب Best منبع را دارد، و [[Totemic]] با [[Surging Totem]] و [[Doom Winds]].

strengths: Both hero trees provide cleave for free, suiting different encounter types
Strong burst cooldowns in single-target and AoE
Crowd Control tools, a low cooldown ranged interrupt and various dispels
Strong mobility and Wind Rush Totem for the group
Skyfury provides Mastery and bonus attacks to allies
weaknesses: A steeper learning curve: juggling multiple mechanics in combat
Requires high uptime and intimate encounter knowledge
Active defensive tools are lacking, so it can struggle if passive defense is not enough
Stormbringer relies heavily on high RNG mechanics
A lot of utility tools are more niche for raids

buffs: October 6 tuning: all ability and auto-attack damage increased by 4% (not PvP)
Lava Lash damage increased by 35% (not PvP)
12.1 brought a solid net buff overall; combined with the new tier set it pushes Stormbringer as the dominant Hero Tree in Season 2
nerfs: Totemic had potency pulled out of Surging Totem and especially Doom Winds AoE burst due to relying more on Imbuement Mastery; its 1-minute burst is still solid but struggles to keep up
changes_12_1.note: 12.1.5 only brings a small Static Accumulation bugfix: overlapping Doom Winds procs no longer disable the effect entirely. The tuning brings Enhancement back to baseline in raids but the spec stays relatively uninspiring on many encounters due to design.

hero.recommendation: Stormbringer is the dominant Hero Tree in Season 2 and is recommended for all Raid and Mythic+ content; it was nerfed far less and benefited more from the Maelstrom Weapon spender buffs, with extremely high burst during Ascendance. Totemic is the alternative: potency was pulled from Surging Totem and Doom Winds AoE burst, so while its 1-minute burst is solid it struggles to keep up.
hero.stormbringer: Has a heavier focus on Maelstrom Weapon spending for Tempest procs; watch out for resource mix-ups with Thunder Capacitor and Storm Unleashed. Its primary strike is Stormstrike and it defaults to Ascendance as its cooldown.
hero.totemic: Adds Surging Totem, a 1-minute cooldown to overlap with Doom Winds. It focuses on Hot Hand windows to cast Lava Lash, extended using Totemic Momentum, and defaults to Doom Winds as its cooldown.

builds.notes: Stormbringer currently is recommended for all Raid and Mythic+ content. In Season 2 Stormbringer has no build swaps and only plays one loadout. Totemic rows exist for all four modes as the alternative tree.

concepts: Avoid Maelstrom Weapon waste: it makes specific spells instant and is spent at 9+ stacks (Lightning Bolt in single target, Chain Lightning in AoE)
Keep strikes on cooldown: Stormbringer prioritizes Stormstrike while Totemic uses Lava Lash; filler priority is Voltaic Blaze, then Crash Lightning, then Stormstrike/Lava Lash
React to procs: both heroes react to the Apex talent and Storm Unleashed plus unique procs; Stormbringer has Tempest and Thunder Capacitor, Totemic has Hot Hand
A priority-list spec with more active buttons than average; the complexity dropped after the Midnight changes but the learning curve remains
st_priority: Cast Tempest / Lightning Bolt with 10 Maelstrom Weapon
Cast Lightning Bolt with 5+ Maelstrom Weapon
aoe_priority: Cast Tempest with a proc and 10 Maelstrom Weapon
Cast Chain Lightning otherwise at 9+ Maelstrom Weapon
Cast Chain Lightning with 5+ Maelstrom Weapon
rotation.aoe_note: Stormbringer in AoE gains increased Maelstrom Weapon generation through Crash Lightning damage splits, ramping the rate of Tempest; Stormstrike remains key with Doom Winds.

cooldowns.Doom Winds: Standard 1-minute cooldown with 8-second duration (10 with Thorim's Invocation), off the GCD; while active your Windfury Weapon chance is increased by 50% (multiplicative) and all Windfury Weapon damage is increased by 20% (does not impact Skyfury bonus attacks); main-hand special attacks rise in value (Stormstrike/Windstrike, Crash Lightning, Sundering/Splitstream and the 3 Primordial Storm strikes); each enemy hit by Crash Lightning's initial cast and any Sundering target counts as a main-hand strike, granting truly uncapped AoE while active; it also gains the effects of Static Accumulation (1/2 Maelstrom Weapon stacks per second) and Thorim's Invocation while active
cooldowns.Ascendance: Stormbringer's default cooldown, used in the opener as soon as possible; Windstrike replaces Stormstrike during it
cooldowns.Sundering: In Midnight it is the mid cooldown burst tool with a 30-second cooldown (no longer incapacitates), dealing large direct Flamestrike damage in a line that can trigger weapon imbues including Windfury Weapon; a staple in all Totemic builds due to Whirling Elements and a high damage burst AoE button elsewhere; Surging Elements makes Sundering casts grant 15% Haste for 12 seconds and generate 5 Maelstrom Weapon instantly
cooldowns.Surging Totem: Totemic's 1-minute cooldown that naturally lines up with Doom Winds
cooldowns.Thorim's Invocation: Extends Doom Winds to 10 seconds and gives a way to spend resources through Stormstrike and Crash Lightning while Doom Winds is active

rotation.hero_notes: Totemic always plays Doom Winds as its cooldown since it naturally lines up with Surging Totem; that window is perfect to overlap with Hot Hand triggers, generating a huge surplus of Maelstrom Weapon through Static Accumulation and spending it through Thorim's Invocation, extending the buff with Totemic Momentum. Stormbringer spends Maelstrom Weapon aggressively for Tempest procs and must avoid mixing Thunder Capacitor and Storm Unleashed resources.
opener: Pre-pot Liquid Luster 12 seconds before the pull (or pre-pot Potion of Recklessness)
Pre-cast Crash Lightning 1 second before pulling
Cast Stormstrike once, using Light's Potential
Cast Voltaic Blaze as soon as its cooldown ends
pre_combat: Apply weapon imbues: Lightning Shield applies them with Instinctive Imbuements
Apply your shield: Lightning Shield also applies Earth Shield with Elemental Orbit
Cast Skyfury to buff your party with Mastery and extra weapon strikes
Use Flask of the Blood Knights and Agility food
Never use Weapon Oils or a Whetstone: they overwrite your weapon imbues
Always have a Healthstone and Concentrated Silvermoon Health Potions

gear.gearing_rules: Overall priority Agility >> Critical Strike = Mastery = Haste >> Versatility; both heroes converged on similar stat priorities aiming to maximize Critical Strike and Mastery for Potion of Recklessness while keeping a healthy amount of Haste to support it. Stormbringer shifted aggressively toward Critical Strike (foregoing Haste) since key Crit items were stripped at the season start, while Totemic favors Mastery = Haste > Critical Strike. Priorities do not change from single-target to multi-target, so one gearset works for everything. 12.1.5 note: with new Kith'ix pieces, ideal catalyst pieces changed to keep secondary stats balanced and maximize cantrips used. Sim with Raidbots.

tier_set.note: 2pc: Voltaic Blaze applies Burning Core to your primary target, causing it to erupt in Fire Nova every 2 seconds for 6 seconds and take 200% increased damage from your Fire Nova effect. 4pc: each Fire Nova you trigger reduces the cooldown of Crash Lightning by 2 seconds and grants a stack of Short Circuit, increasing the damage of your next Crash Lightning by 8% per stack up to 5 times. With the 2-piece equipped Voltaic Blaze becomes a top priority for both heroes, and keeping Crash Lightning on cooldown avoids wasting the CDR.

mplus.hero_note: Stormbringer is the Best-tagged hero for Mythic+/AoE this season: Crash Lightning damage splits increase Maelstrom Weapon generation and ramp Tempest, while Doom Winds grants truly uncapped AoE since every Crash Lightning and Sundering target counts as a main-hand strike.
tips: Cast Crash Lightning on cooldown: its splits fund Maelstrom Weapon and the 4pc set turns it into a CDR engine
Cast Chain Lightning at 9+ Maelstrom Weapon (Tempest first when a proc and 10 stacks are up)
Use Voltaic Blaze on cooldown: the 2-piece set makes it a top priority button for both heroes
Overlap Ascendance, Doom Winds and Potion of Recklessness in the pull window
Totemic players should line Surging Totem with Doom Winds and dump surplus Maelstrom Weapon inside it via Thorim's Invocation
